Minimal library used to interact with the [Mattermost](https://mattermost.com) chat server.

Used mainly by [matterircd](https://github.com/42wim/matterircd), a minimal Mattermost to IRC bridge.

## Compatibility

- Compatible and tested with Mattermost 10.x, 11.x
